task_title: Fix Floor 2 merchant AI visits and purchases

plan_review.notes: The separate plan review correctly identified Floor 2 default-off routing as the blocker. Direct code trace confirmed its proposed shop-preview changes already exist: buildEquipmentCandidates filters to purchasable offers and evaluateEquipmentLoadoutCandidates selects only positive DPS/survivability utility; bestSwapInstanceId is already part of the fingerprint. Resolution: add a CLI-only Floor 2 auto-enable in a pure resolver, leaving the runner's own Floor 2 default off (its default-off regression guard in tests/headless/settlement-return-routing.test.ts is retained unchanged). No new dependencies or modules.

rounds.summary: Independent code review of the repaired CLI resolver and runner wiring found no actionable concerns.

Copilot PR review found (1) the ledger's plan-review note misdescribed the test change — the Floor 2 runner default-off guard was never replaced, and the only new coverage exercised the pure resolver, leaving the real CLI-to-runner wiring unverified under AGENTS.md rule 9; (2) the PR body still described a superseded implementation that set enforcePlayabilityInvariants: false. Resolved by correcting this note, adding tests/unit/ai/headless-runner-cli-wiring.test.ts (loads the real headless-runner-cli.ts entrypoint and captures the exact config handed to runHeadless; mutation-verified to fail when the resolved-option spread regresses) plus a real-pipeline headless test that feeds parseArgs/resolveHeadlessRunnerOptions output through runHeadless on Floor 2, and rewriting the PR description from the actual diff.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly enables Floor 2 settlement-return routing in the CLI while preserving explicit overrides, existing Floor 1 behavior, and playability invariant enforcement. The pure resolver is well-tested, targeted integration coverage passes, and typecheck/lint are clean. The diff is surgical, deterministic, policy-compliant, and maintainable.
